name: How To Wait On God
overview: Waiting on God is portrayed in Scripture as an exercise of faith and confident hope in His faithful work within believers. Psalms 27:13 reveals that trusting to witness the Lord's goodness sustains us in difficult times, while Isaiah 40:31 promises renewed strength and perseverance for those who wait on Him. Philippians 1:6 assures believers that God will faithfully complete the good work He has begun in them, and Hebrews 11:6 emphasizes that faith and diligent seeking are essential to pleasing God. Additionally, James 1:2 encourages rejoicing through trials, which often accompany the waiting process, highlighting the spiritual growth that comes from trusting God’s timing.
